supporting.title: Wake up at the same time each day

days.title: Pick one time each day for your habit and do it for {minutes} minutes
days.reason: Doing things at the same time makes them automatic.

days.title: Stretch gently for {minutes} minutes after you wake up
days.reason: A short morning routine sets the tone for the day.

days.title: Spend {minutes} minutes tidying one small space
days.reason: A tidy space can make the day feel calmer.

days.title: Take a {minutes}-minute walk at the same time as yesterday
days.reason: Same time, same place helps a habit stick.

days.title: Spend {minutes} minutes getting ready for tomorrow
days.reason: Getting ready the night before makes mornings easier.

days.title: Do your habit for {minutes} minutes right after something you already do
days.reason: Linking a new habit to an old one helps you remember.

days.title: Spend {minutes} minutes looking back at your week
days.reason: Looking back helps you see how far you have come.
